originalSourceText:
Q.2  Why  is a cubic polynomial commonly selected for  rest-to-rest  joint  trajectory
          generation?

         (A) It minimizes computation time.

          (B) It satisfies exactly four boundary conditions.

          (C) It guarantees C² continuity.

         (D) It eliminates inverse kinematics.

          Explanation: (B) Refer slide 11 in Lecture Joint-Space Scheme

      A cubic polynomial has four coefficients, allowing  it to satisfy four boundary
           conditions: initial/final positions and initial/final velocities.
